subject: Governance handbook + Week 1 cadence — scheduling + invite
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Tan <julie.tan@medalign.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governance handbook + Week 1 cadence — scheduling + invite

Hi Julie —

Congrats again on the contract sign — excited to get MedAlign into production. Before we kick off the technical onboarding, I wanted to share a short governance handbook draft (attached) that outlines decision owners, escalation paths, and data handling assumptions for the first 90 days.

Two quick asks so we can finalize the Week 1 kickoff invite:
1) Confirm who from MedAlign will be the primary approver for production security checks (name + email).
2) Confirm three 60-minute windows next week when your delivery and IT leads can join a call — we prefer a single call that combines access/SSO, network allowlist, and initial model validation.

Tentative internal roster: Camila (CSM), Ben (Implementation Lead), Neha (Solutions Engineer).

I attached: MedAlign_Onboarding_Governance.pdf (draft) and a proposed Week1_Cadence_Agenda.docx. If a separate vendor IT-only session is needed, happy to split.

Thanks — I’ll wait for attendee names and times.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-2411
[attachment: MedAlign_Onboarding_Governance.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: Week1_Cadence_Agenda.docx (docx)]

From: Julie Tan <julie.tan@medalign.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medalign.com>, MedAlign IT <it@medalign.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance handbook + Week 1 cadence — scheduling + invite

Camila — thanks for sending this over and congrats to both teams. We reviewed the draft and it looks good overall. A few notes inline, but answers below: 

- Primary approver for production security checks: Carlos Rivera (c.rivera@medalign.com). He owns compliance and will be on the call.
- Preferred windows next week (PST):
  * Tue 2026-11-17 10:00–11:00
  * Wed 2026-11-18 14:00–15:00
  * Thu 2026-11-19 08:30–09:30

We’d like the call to be public-facing (Redwood + product owners + IT) — Carlos and I will attend; Sarah L. from Integrations might join if schedules allow (I’ll confirm).

A couple of comments: please include a short runbook for SSO test steps (we use Okta) and an expectation table for what constitutes a validated model run vs. acceptance criteria. Otherwise the governance doc reads well.

Julie
Senior PM, MedAlign Health
julie.tan@medalign.com | 617-555-0102

When: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:00–11:00 PST (calendar invite sent)
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=Week1
Dial-in: +1 888-555-1212 (US)
Agenda highlights (attachments updated):
- 00:00–00:10 — Intros & scope (Camila)
- 00:10–00:30 — SSO & allowlist steps (Neha)
- 00:30–00:50 — Model validation: acceptance criteria & demo (Ben)
